claims.claim: King’s College London researchers found that urolithin A improved heart-muscle contraction strength by up to 80 percent in models of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction.
claims.supporting_quote: A compound produced in the body after eating pomegranates improves heart function by up to 80%, particularly for a type of heart failure with limited treatment options.
